name: skyhook-tunnel
description: High-performance QUIC & WebSocket reverse-tunnel and proxy system

scripts.postinstall: cd server && go mod tidy || true
scripts.dev:server: cd server && HTTP_PORT=17356 nodemon -e go --watch . --exec "go run ."
scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run build:server
scripts.build:ui: npm --prefix ui run build && mkdir -p server/dist && cp -r ui/dist/* server/dist/
scripts.test: npm run test:cli && npm run test:server
scripts.test:server: cd server && go test -count=1 ./... && go build -o /dev/null .

author: gkucmierz
